Speak Language (specific)

Training Time (TT): 12 weeks

The ability to understand and be understood in a certain language. Characters are rated in their proficiency with a language on a four-tiered scale, as follows:

  • Advanced
  • Native
  • Fluent
  • Basic

A speaker who is at least +10 (Native) on this scale can pass himself off as a native. Below are examples of languages

  • Atlantean (archaic, usually spoken by scholars)
  • Goregon
  • Zoran
  • Nymphas, etc.

Skill Rating Language Proficiency

  • +0 to +3 Basic
  • +4 to +9 Fluent
  • +10 or greater Native
